newsitem.title: USA: Jones Medical completes Abana acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Jones Medical completes Abana acquisition.

text.p: Jones Medical Industries Inc said Thursday it completed the acquisition of Abana Pharmaceuticals Inc of Birmingham, Ala., effective December 31. It had held a 16 percent stake in the company since 1992.
Jones Medical issued about 420,000 shares of common stock in exchange for the 84 percent of Abana held by other investors.

Abana markets specialty prescription pharmaceuticals, principally branded generic products used by internists in treating chronic conditions and respiratory ailments. Its 1996 sales were about $6 million.
